integrity: Analytic Gaussian-integral proof of full singular spectrum and strict phase comparison. Finite numerical checks are supplementary and are not substituted for an infinite-dimensional proof. No external independent review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only one-variable normalized Gaussian Fock space, real common contraction 0<r<1, nonzero quadratic weights satisfying 2|t|,2|s|<1-r^2. No endpoint, affine, or higher-dimensional claims. Priority not independently certified.
title: Strict singular-value ordering by relative squeezing phase in Fock cross products
